name: Love Pheromone
source:
"You either have it all or you lose it all! It’s only one of the two in this world.”💋

“You” have a very special love pheromone where the scent decides your class.
Your love pheromone can evoke human instinctual impulses!
Is this power a blessing or a curse?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.lovepheromone]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“你要么拥有一切，要么失去一切！这只是这个世界上两者之一。”💋

“你”有一种非常特殊的爱情信息素，气味决定了你的阶级。
你的爱情信息素可以唤起人类的本能冲动！
这种力量是祝福还是诅咒？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.lovepheromone]Google Play[/url]]
